items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: That's the Magnolia band with Jew Oliver. ... That's Jew Oliver in that time when I was the manager of the band.

ctx.x: Uh, the photographs you made? Yeah. Let me think. I don't remember now. Well, when you have a spare time. When you have a spare time. It must have changed. You've shown it to me before.

When you have a spare time, I'll let you see his photograph because I got it from my sister. I got it over here. She had it and brought it here. I got it over here. Well, it's a T4 from here. I done framed it. Oh, yeah. And I framed it with Freddie and myself and my Freddie, my daddy, and myself up in that frame up there. When you get ready, you can, oh, yeah. You can take and just take and look at it as long as you wish to look at it. That's what the Magnolia... That's the Magnolia band with Jew Oliver.
